title: runner: ClaudeCodeRunner for work, review, job and command runs
body:
## What
`ClaudeCodeRunner` (`crates/boba-runner/src/claude/`) runs the real `claude` CLI for all four `RunKind`s, implementing the `Runner` trait unchanged.

| Kind | Where | Ends with |
|---|---|---|
| Work | worktree `<data>/worktrees/T-<n>` on `boba/T-<n>-<slug>` (reused on change rounds, `--resume`) | commit leftovers → push → open/reuse PR → `PrOpened` |
| Review | detached worktree at `pull/<n>/head`, or `source.head_branch` for imported PRs | ```` ```boba-verdict ```` → `verdict` / `feedback` |
